id: title:TueHaulund:tidy the spend chart and drop the dev quota scenarios

review.posthog_relevance: Changes to the Spend Trajectory chart and its underlying quota calculation, potentially affecting displayed values and cached behavior.
review.reason: The observed changes are localized to the frontend Spend Trajectory chart and its associated quota-scenario fixtures. P1.F1.H1 updates cached snapshot hashes, P1.F4.H3 changes the spentTotal calculation, P1.F4.H12 and P1.F4.H13 adjust visual rendering and label positioning, and P1.F5.H3 removes a dev-only fixture. While these changes could affect displayed values and cached results
review.uncertainty: The complete impact on cached behavior and displayed values cannot be verified without execution or broader context; no tier 2 or 3 systemic benefit is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the score assignment. The instructions require returning JSON with observations and limitations, not a score. The score assignment is a separate step.

observations.behavior: Changes snapshot hashes, removing a quota scenario dependency, and refactoring a spend trajectory chart. P1.F1.H1: Replaces snapshot hashes. P1.F2.H1: Removes quota scenario import. P1.F2.H2: Removes quota scenario usage, retaining quota. P1.F3.H1: Adds tests for chart behavior. P1.F4.H1: Adds AXIS_CLEARANCE, removes BELOW. P1.F4.H2: Adds Dot component. P1.F4.H3: Changes spentTotal

observations.limitations: This chunk removes P1.F6.H1 entirely, replacing a dev-only quota-scenario fixture with no replacement. P1.F4.H12 and P1.F4.H13 are UI changes. P1.F5.H2 and P1.F5.H3 remove the removed fixture's usage. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a non-scaling-stroke vector effect to a chart line; replaces a circle marker with a Dot component; adjusts label Y position.
